- [USER] User believes that using social media is a great way to improve customer experience, allowing entrepreneurs to engage with customers, provide support, and offer promotions.

- [USER] User inquires if there is such a thing as too much social media presence and if entrepreneurs can overdo it.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Entrepreneurs can overdo social media, potentially harming their brand.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Quality over quantity is important; posting frequently without value can decrease engagement.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Authenticity is key; overly salesy posts can lead to audience disinterest.
